en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an ornate dark border framing an oval photograph of a town. The view shows densely packed tile‑roofed houses and several church towers rising above them, set against a barren hillside in the background. The style and print quality suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. There is printed caption text below the image and a faint circular stamp on the left. A website watermark (not original to the card) appears across the lower right of the image.
